newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks seen up on new accounts day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks seen up on new accounts day.

text.p: Pakistan stocks were likely to open up on Wednesday on buying of blue chips on the new accounts day, but dealers said a technical correction was due.
"The index has surged sharply during last few sessions and the bull run is likely to continue today, the new accounts day," a dealer said. "But now a technical correction is due."
On Tuesday, the index rose 34.49 points to end at 1,726.17. Gainers led losers 135 to 122. Turnover rose to 81.79 million shares from 51.49 million in the previous session.
